events.title: People, Not Widgets - Lessons learned from applying systems thinking and analytics to social services delivery
events.description: Ryan Orsinger will share perspectives, lessons learned, and new horizons in applying data and research in the homeless services space. He'll speak to systems design challenges, ethical AI/ML implementation, and how best to bring analytical tools to bear on social services data. His aim is for the talk to be valuable for a technical audience, but no specific ML/stats/LLM skills are needed.

events.title: ACM San Antonio Monthly Meetup - May 2026
events.description: ACM San Antonio is a local community for people who care about computing. Learning it, building with it, and connecting with others who do. Our goal is to grow interest in modern computing and create a welcoming space for education, collaboration, and communication across the San Antonio tech community.
